title: H2: hub enforces §8.6; refuses GCE and PSK (revises .3.10)
description: Revises decision mimid-1wgh.3.10 (hub enforces only §8.1 membership + canSendMessage), which let any participant rewrite roles_list/preauth or replace the app_data_dictionary.
